levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي

notes: the first «حدثنا» pairs the compiler's father (bare «أبي», a relation) with Muhammad b. al-Hasan; the four «جميعا قالوا» teachers form one level
the Imam named inside the chain after «عن» is a narrator (owner ruling 2); «عليه السلام» is left out
the Imam's words after «قال» are the saying; the story of Joseph is his narration
